title: Incorrect error handling when compiler_set_qualname fails
author: iritkatriel
body_preview: `compiler_set_qualname` is called at the end of `_PyCompile_EnterScope`, after the compiler entered the scope. If it fails, `_PyCompile_EnterScope` returns error (without reverting the scope entry) and the caller would assume that there was no change in scope.    <!-- gh-linked-prs --> ### Linked PRs * gh-156461 * gh-156462 <!-- /gh-linked-prs -->
